body.objective: Decide whether the newly certified 70-component two-phase counterflow causal BV parent becomes a physically healthy and charge-compatible reduced classical theory on the selected fixed-Q_rel Berger leaf.
body.stop_condition: Import TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_CAUSAL_BV_PARENT_V1, its payload/receiver contract, the complete 54-row positive-Berger parent and the trace-charge preflight by exact hashes; do not reconstruct them. Build the fixed-Q_rel derived level set or homotopy fibre while retaining the global relative-charge coordinate until the reduction map is explicit. Compute the exact physical cohomology and descended covariant/shifted symplectic form sector by sector on the full S3 Hodge/harmonic carrier, including homogeneous, exact, coexact and exceptional zero modes. Give the inertia and radical after every contractible, diagonal-U1, diffeomorphism and Weyl row is removed, and identify the surviving relative-phase and dressed-trace representatives. Compute the complete reduced principal/characteristic polynomial, geometric multiplicities and Jordan chains; require no real exponential root, defective characteristic or secular generalized mode in the declared physical scalar/clock sector. Audit Q_diag, Q_rel, D and K=D-Omega R_rel separately on the unrestricted parent and on the fixed-charge fibre, proving or refuting D-degeneracy rather than inferring it from diagonal charge neutrality. PASS only if one positive relative-clock direction survives, no negative physical scalar survives, the reduced propagation is healthy in the declared class and D is null on the stated leaf. Otherwise certify the first exact failed property. Supply exact bases/maps, independent verifier, sign/charge/Jordan mutations, schema, receipt, report and atlas fragment.

body.forbid: no replay of the certified 70-row parent; no deletion of the Q_rel zero mode before constructing the derived fibre; no homogeneous-only positivity promotion; no velocity-Hessian-only health claim; no use of a Hadamard or quantum positivity vocabulary; no identification of K with raw D; no claim beyond the selected Berger background and declared fixed-charge leaf
